Useless. People who are spiteful will just disagree and downvote.

The reason why I don't think that this will be implemented is because Voat seems to trying to get people to comment more not less. Right now if you disagree, but a downvote isn't appropriate you can comment and explain your position. This is better than upvotes and downvotes and sidevotes and crossvotes. Another way to quietly, anonymously punish someone for their differing opinions isn't what this site needs.

In fact, I don't even like up and downvotes all that much, though I do understand you need some system. But votes aren't perfect, because once you have a sufficiently large population of one type of person they just abuse the voting system and use it to make anyone disagreeing with them invisible. It's just human nature and occasionally I've forgotten that the downvote button isn't a 'disagree' button and have to correct a downvote I've give just because someone said something I don't like.

I think surveys are what's needed, they will do the same thing except for a few differences:

  • A survey would show a variety of opinions on a given topic

  • A survey would provide more complete information on real opinions

You're not serving any purpose by adding agree/disagree to comments. There won't be any counter arguments in a single comment. It would be fruitless. Another problem is that agreeing/disagreeing will not provide any useful information because not everyone will weigh in their opinion. Finally, disagreeing/agreeing is too polarized for real opinions.

My alternative is a bona fide survey system for voat.
